purpose: Directory of relevant community support, confidential advocacy, clinical ethics and pastoral resources; separate narrowly relevant professional evidence for independent investigation. Not a distribution list or established coalition.
scope_and_privacy: Resources are for appropriate service requests, confidential legal intake, or voluntary de-identified policy dialogue. No allegations or private medical records should be broadcast to community or spiritual organizations.

No relatives, private associates, donors, unrelated alumni networks, award sponsors or former affiliations are compiled as outreach targets. Public profile links are evidence references, not lists of recipients.
Past affiliations, honors and titles do not establish current regulatory authority or complicity. Only documented relationships material to the case should be verified by authorized investigators.
Invite a willing organization to designate a representative; do not equate a response, membership, faith or affiliation with agreement or endorsement.
Witnesses including family members of the complainant may provide firsthand testimony privately to appropriate investigators, with consent; do not publish contact information or private testimony.
Professional facts are dated public institutional descriptions, not proof of the allegations. Individual license status and public disciplinary records have not been separately verified.

professional_evidence.limits: Current institutional profile alone does not establish employment or medical privileges on a particular historical date. Verify incident records, legal entity, supervision and disciplinary history with competent investigators.
